name: gotcha-memory
description: Standalone operational learning loop: a failure becomes knowledge. The postflight records Bash failures (classified by error family); a failure that recurs >=N times within a window becomes a GOTCHA; the preflight injects the lesson into stderr BEFORE the next run of the same task. Curated gotchas (your rules) are always-on by substring. Local JSONL, stdlib only, WARN-not-block.
